structuredOutput.summary: Added gates/base.py with align (inner-join on index, series_a order) and make_report (deep-cast numpy scalars; ValueError on non-finite floats). IdentityDegeneracyBlade scans |spearmanr| over refs × lags |k'|≤k, skips/counts insufficient-overlap and degenerate pairs, flags when max ≥ rho_max, and reports max/second-max plus n_effective_hypotheses=|refs|×(2k+1). PoolRedundancyBlade compares the candidate to each pool member at lag 0 with both pearsonr and spearmanr, reports max and top-5 for each, and flags when either max ≥ rho_pool. gates/__init__.py exports both classes. tests/test_gates_identity_pool.py covers lag-copy, noise, second-max, min_overlap/all-skipped, constant-ref JSON, pearson/spearman divergence, CertifiedRun screen/record smoke, and determinism.

files_changed.purpose: Export IdentityDegeneracyBlade and PoolRedundancyBlade; document v0.3 blade set.
Minimal align + make_report helpers used by the two blades on this ticket.
IdentityDegeneracyBlade: lagged |spearmanr| vs refs, rho_max as constructor input.
PoolRedundancyBlade: lag-0 |pearsonr| and |spearmanr| vs pool, rho_pool as constructor input.
Red-first tests for blades a–g including CertifiedRun screen/record smoke.
